items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: The transcript mentions Rev. Adair only in the context of a concert tribute organized by others (Mrs. Thelma Adair, Rev. Kumi Dwamena). The interviewee, Sam Wooding, does not speak, nor is any personal connection or interaction between Sam Wooding and Rev. Adair described.

ctx.x: This concert was held to raise funds for a stained-glass window to be dedicated in the memory of the late Rev. Arthur Eugene Adair.

'This program is a fitting tribute to Rev. Adair, who encouraged and promoted all types of music in the church,' said Mrs. Thelma Adair. 'To help the church purchase its pipe organ, Rev. Adair contributed a year of his salary.'
Rev. Adair founded Mt. Morris Presbyterian Church in 1942 and served as its pastor up until his death on Dec. 11, 1979.
